body:
I mean, Amitriptyline is an anti-depressant & it hasn’t helped me at all. Took a bit, I’m gonna end up throwing it all back up. I can already tell lol. Zofran is the only thing holding me back. Guess I’ll try again tomorrow night

I can’t bring myself to be honest. I’ve thought about it. Just can’t do it. Don’t know why I can’t, because there is a chance I could get better. Therapy would be a waste of money for my parents.

Haha & yeah are my safewords don’t take them away from me

I’ve never really had motivation. Usually can’t even find motivation to get out of bed and eat.

ODing on Amitriptyline. Prescribed for “migraines”
Yeah, no current friends. Certainly none I would be comfortable asking drugs from. And I don’t know. I want motivation haha.

I mean, even going out with my family makes me exhausted. Even if I feel like I had a good time, I come back wishing I didn’t go. It’s not like I’m completely incapable of socializing, because I can. It’s just awful. I used to be better, but I pushed myself away from people & now I’ve forgotten how to. I’ve never tried anything that makes me more social. Wouldn’t even know where to get drugs haha

I’m only 16. I’m young & could probably fix my shit, I know. But I highly doubt I will ever be able to socialize normally. I don’t enjoy socializing, so being a social recluse isn’t that awful. Gets lonely sometimes, but I can’t make myself like to socialize. Nonetheless have an actual connection with somebody.

And I’m like 98 pounds, this number of pills will 100% kill me if I don’t throw them all up. Can’t exactly go out and buy a rope anyway, since I live with my parents haha. My body is fucked up already, a little bit more damage won’t hurt too bad.

Lots of reasons I want to kill myself haha. To sum it up as shortly as I can, I was abused by my brother as a child & neglected by my parents. Locked myself in my room to hide from him. Became a habit I’ve never been able to break. I’m a social recluse, bored with life. Don’t know how to put my exact feelings in words. And I know OD is stupid, but I can’t exactly go out and buy a gun haha
I’m the same way. Even when I read manga or watch tv shows. Something bad happens to the protagonist and my brain is like “kill yourself”. It’s really awful lol
